title: OVSBondsResponse
description: Payload from GET /api/v1/ovs/bonds/{node} (ovn-recon-1tw.7): the runtime state of the bonds inside one node's OVS bridges, parsed from `ovs-appctl bond/show` (no argument: every bond) run in the node's ovnkube-node pod, container ovn-controller. Read live on every request (a memo of a few seconds aside), never cached. NodeNetworkState carries the bonds' configuration; this carries what OVS is doing with it.

sourceHealth.description: `ok` when read live; `degraded` when the live probe failed and the node's fixture, or an empty list, is served instead (with a `LIVE_PROBE_FAILED` warning).

warnings.description: `LIVE_PROBE_FAILED`: bond/show could not be run on the node; `bonds` is the node's fixture or empty, not live state.

bonds.description: One entry per `---- <name> ----` block, in OVS's order. Empty on a node without OVS bonds. Every field but `name` and `members` is absent when OVS printed no line for it.

name.description: The bond's OVS port name, as NodeNetworkState's bridge.port[].name spells it.

nextRebalanceMs.description: next rebalance; printed only for a balancing mode.

activeBackupPrimary.description: active-backup primary: the configured primary member. Absent (or null) when OVS prints <none>.

activeMember.description: active member mac: <mac>(<member>). Absent when no member is active.

members.description: One entry per `member <name>: enabled|disabled` block, in OVS's order.

active.description: The block carries an `active member` line.

mayEnable.description: may_enable: OVS would enable the member (carrier up, LACP in agreement); differs from `enabled` during updelay or downdelay.
